# CruxCut

> CruxCut is an AI climbing video editor available for iPhone and Android, made by dkdev (Republic of Korea). It is not iOS-only: the iPhone app is on the App Store and the Android app is live on Google Play. CruxCut automatically follows the climber in fixed tripod footage, finds crux-worthy moments, and turns the climbing path into a shareable sticker. Video analysis runs on the user's phone.

## Availability

- iPhone: [CruxCut on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6771268613) (iOS 18 or later).
- Android: [CruxCut on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.threepointlab.cruxcut) (package `com.threepointlab.cruxcut`, listed as "AI Climb Video Editor: CruxCut").
- The Android app includes automatic climber tracking, move-by-move segmentation, crux highlights, manual path correction, in-app recording, overlays, and 9:16, 3:4, or 1:1 export.
- Supported devices and regions are listed in each store.

## What CruxCut makes

- AI Follow-cam: turns fixed wide climbing footage into a tighter edit that follows the climber with automatic pan and zoom.
- Crux Highlights: surfaces difficult and dynamic sections as short clips or multi-climb highlight reels.
- Path Stickers: visualizes the climbing path with details such as grade and result for sharing as a workout record.

## Key facts

- Processing: video analysis and editing happen on the user's phone (iPhone or Android). Raw climbing footage does not need to be uploaded to a processing server.
- Processing time varies with video length, device and tracking conditions.
- Works with lead climbing and bouldering, indoors and outdoors, from tripod or handheld footage.
- If tracking loses the climber, the user can draw the climbing route and CruxCut re-identifies the climber and refines the tracking path.

## 한국어 요약

CruxCut(크럭스컷)은 iPhone과 Android 모두에서 사용할 수 있는 AI 클라이밍 영상 편집 앱입니다. iPhone은 App Store, Android는 Google Play에서 다운로드할 수 있으며, iOS 전용 앱이 아닙니다. 삼각대로 찍은 고정 영상을 클라이머를 따라가는 들찍으로 바꾸고, 크럭스 하이라이트를 찾아주며, 등반 경로를 경로 스티커로 만들어 공유할 수 있습니다. 분석과 편집은 휴대폰 안에서 처리되며 처리를 위한 서버 업로드가 필요하지 않습니다. 지원 기기와 지역은 각 스토어에서 확인하세요. 운영: dkdev. 문의: support@cruxcut.com
